project.name: harness :: policy (capability x scope x TTL)
project.description: The governance core: autonomy levels (01 §5.3), the capability x scope x TTL decision engine (01 §5.2), the approval state machine with a mandatory natural-human anchor (02 R-02), the escalation router with a hard hop cap (02 R-06) and the automatic degradation rules (01 §14.4). Pure logic, no I/O, no framework.
